source.snippet: Tell HN: Google Argon on a Pro subscription is worthless. One prompt which took 5 minutes of clock time used 50% of the resources of a Pro account for the 5 hour window. [7 points, 6 comments]

problem_statement: Paying users of AI Pro subscriptions burn through quota unpredictably in a single session, making the subscription feel worthless and blocking productive work for hours.
target_segment: Knowledge workers, developers, and freelancers on paid AI platform subscriptions (e.g., $20–$200/month plans) who rely on AI for billable or deadline-driven work.
notes: User is a paying Pro subscriber — confirmed buyer. Pain is quota unpredictability causing multi-hour outages. Opportunity: a quota-aware AI session manager or usage dashboard that alerts before burnout and routes to fallback models. Adjacent to prior signals on AI API cost monitoring.
